import os,json,shutil,subprocess,stat
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/srv/projects/skill-universal')
cache=root/'.runtime/npm-cache/_cacache'
res={'scope':'Ferrari private npm download cache only','status':'ABORTED','other_projects_touched':False}
def need(x,m):
 if not x:raise RuntimeError(m)
def free():s=os.statvfs(str(root));return s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize
def ver(p,a):
 r=subprocess.run([str(p),*a],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=26)
 return r.returncode==0
try:
 need(os.geteuid()==0 and root.is_dir() and not root.is_symlink(),'Ferrari physical root invalid')
 need((root/'.runtime/npm/rea/node_modules/rea-agents/package.json').is_file(),'REA missing')
 need((root/'runtimes/jdk-25.0.5_8/bin/java').is_file(),'private Java missing')
 tools={'apktool':('tools/apktool-3.0.3/bin/apktool',['--version']),'aapt2':('tools/android-cli-36.0.0/build-tools/36.0.0/aapt2',['version']),'apksigner':('tools/android-cli-36.0.0/build-tools/36.0.0/apksigner',['--version']),'adb':('tools/android-cli-36.0.0/platform-tools/adb',['version']),'zipalign':('tools/android-cli-36.0.0/build-tools/36.0.0/zipalign',['-h'])}
 need(all((root/p).is_file() and not (root/p).is_symlink() for p,a in tools.values()),'private binaries missing')
 need(all(ver(root/p,a) for k,(p,a) in tools.items() if k!='zipalign'),'Ferrari tools fail before')
 need(cache.exists() and cache.is_dir() and not cache.is_symlink(),'only known npm cache directory can be cleaned')
 need(cache.resolve()==root/'.runtime/npm-cache/_cacache','cache directory is not canonical')
 for proc in Path('/proc').iterdir():
  if not proc.name.isdecimal():continue
  try:
   cwd=os.readlink(proc/'cwd')
   need(not cwd.startswith(str(cache)),'process has cache working dir')
   for fd in (proc/'fd').iterdir():
    try:target=os.readlink(fd)
    except OSError:continue
    need(not target.startswith(str(cache)),'process holds cache open')
  except (OSError,ProcessLookupError,PermissionError):pass
 before=free()
 shutil.rmtree(cache)
 need(not cache.exists(),'npm cache not removed')
 need((root/'.runtime/npm/rea/node_modules/rea-agents/package.json').is_file(),'REA changed')
 need(all(ver(root/p,a) for k,(p,a) in tools.items() if k!='zipalign'),'Ferrari tools fail after')
 res.update(status='PASS',freed_bytes=free()-before,space_free_bytes=free(),REA_private_preserved=True,Android_private_pass=True,Apktool_private_pass=True)
except Exception as e:res['error']=type(e).__name__+': '+str(e)[:220]
print(json.dumps(res,ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True))
